subject: Request for Amendment to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

Please review the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference.

We found the following discrepancies that require your immediate attention.

For the Consignee, the Shipping Instruction shows EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

For the Notify Party, the Shipping Instruction shows EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction.

Shipping Operations
